home.tagline: Cross-platform SSH terminal and file transfer

connect.agentHint: Uses the keys already loaded in your SSH agent.
connect.interactiveHint: The server will prompt for passwords or one-time codes during sign-in.

hosts.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete folder "{name}" and everything inside it?

hostDialog.x11Hint: Experimental. Requires a local X server; remote GUI apps render here.
hostDialog.noTags: No tags yet. Use Manage tags to create some.
hostDialog.folderHint: Folders can contain hosts and other folders.

tags.title: Manage tags
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It will be removed from all hosts.
tags.name: Tag name
tags.duplicate: A tag with this name already exists.

connectHost.title: Connect to {name}
connectHost.keyboardInteractiveHint: Authentication prompts will appear after the connection starts.

import.title: Import hosts
import.placeholder: Paste the contents of an OpenSSH config, Xshell session or FinalShell JSON file.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themePackHint: Install a theme plugin to add more palettes.
settings.themeImportHint: Supports iTerm2 .itermcolors presets and Ferriterm .toml schemes.
settings.languagePackHint: More languages appear here when language-pack plugins are installed.
settings.credentialsHint: Passwords are stored in the system keychain. When it is unavailable, Ferriterm keeps them in an encrypted local vault.
settings.keepaliveHint: Sends a keepalive packet at this interval; 0 disables it.
settings.osc52: Allow remote programs to write the clipboard
settings.osc52Hint: tmux, vim and remote shells use OSC 52 to copy text through the terminal. Disable to block clipboard writes from the remote host.
settings.highlightsHint: Matching output is tinted on a best-effort basis; alternate-screen apps are not highlighted. Case-insensitive.
settings.tabNumberingHint: Show a number before each session tab title.
settings.confirmClose: Confirm before closing a running session
settings.confirmCloseHint: Ask for confirmation when a tab with an active process is closed.
settings.sftpShowHiddenHint: New SFTP panes start with hidden files visible.
settings.appearanceHint: Changes apply to open terminals immediately.
settings.fontFamilyHint: Comma-separated font stack used by the terminal.
settings.scrollbackHint: Number of lines kept in terminal history.

forward.title: Port forwarding
forward.hint: Tunnel traffic through an active SSH session: expose a local port, open a server port back to this machine, or run a SOCKS5 proxy.
forward.dynamicHint: Point applications at this SOCKS5 proxy; the destination is chosen per connection.
forward.remoteHint: The SSH server listens on the remote address and forwards connections back to a target reachable from this machine.
forward.connections: {count, plural, =0 {No connections} one {# connection} other {# connections}}
forward.saveRuleHint: Saved rules start automatically when the host connects.

commands.title: Quick commands
commands.name: Label
commands.historyEmpty: Commands you run will appear here.
commands.variablesHint: Fill in the template variables, then insert the command into the focused terminal.

sync.title: Encrypted backup
sync.hint: Export hosts and tags into a passphrase-protected .ftbak file, or restore one. Restored hosts merge with existing data; duplicates are skipped.
sync.remoteHint: Upload the encrypted backup to a GitHub Gist or a WebDAV server. The passphrase above encrypts the payload before it leaves this device.
sync.gistIdPlaceholder: Leave empty to create a new secret gist
sync.gistIdHint: The ID is stored below after the first upload.
sync.downloaded: Downloaded backup: {added} hosts imported ({skipped} already present)
sync.desktopOnly: Cloud sync is available in the desktop app.
sync.deleteExtra: Delete extra entries in the target
sync.deleteExtraHint: Entries that do not exist in the source will be deleted from the target.
sync.summary: {dirs} folders, {files} files, {bytes} to copy, {deletes} to delete

transfer.title: File transfer
transfer.chooseSession: Choose an SSH session and a destination folder first.
transfer.empty: No transfers yet. Double-click a file to edit it, or use the menu to send it.
transfer.mountHint: Mount a WebDAV folder or an S3 bucket as a file pane target. Credentials are kept in memory for this session only.

files.name: Name
files.fastDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete "{name}" and all of its contents? This cannot be undone.
files.permissionsHint: Toggle read, write and execute for each class.

editor.title: Edit {name}
editor.conflict: This file changed on disk after you opened it. Reload to get the latest version before saving.
editor.tooLarge: This file is too large to edit in place. Use transfer instead.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.empty: No recordings yet. Start one from the red dot on a session tab.
recordings.select: Select a recording to replay it here.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.editHint: Click Change, then press the new key combination. Backspace disables the shortcut; Escape cancels.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No active sessions} one {# active session} other {# active sessions}}
sessions.closeConfirmBody: "{title}" is still running. Close it anyway?

about.description: Cross-platform SSH terminal and file transfer.
about.cleanRoom: An independent implementation; no source code, icons or UI strings from other products are included.

empty.hint: Pick a host or fill the quick connect form, or open a local terminal

broadcast.title: Broadcast input
broadcast.hint: Keystrokes typed in any terminal are also sent to the sessions selected below.
broadcast.productionWarning: {count} selected session(s) are production hosts. Commands will run there as well.
broadcast.confirmProduction: I understand: Broadcast input may run commands on production hosts.

hostKey.title: Verify host key
hostKey.message: The authenticity of {host} cannot be established yet. Compare the fingerprint with the server administrator before trusting it.
hostKey.changedWarning: The key presented by this server differs from the one you trusted before. This may indicate a man-in-the-middle attack or a reinstalled server.

log.title: Execution log
log.empty: Run a command to see it logged here.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Drop plugin packages into the plugins folder: language packs, themes, command packs, or WASM bundles with a manifest.json.
